due_when.clears_when: `git status --porcelain` is empty immediately after a local `scripts/ci/run_guards.py` run that did produce pytest-report.xml.

origin.ref: Manager session 2026-09-21 (session_01XQhayAHWdrSYv8jN54P2HH); the stop-hook reported untracked files and the file was a transient pytest-report.xml from a still-running guards job.
origin.rerun: cd <repo> && timeout 400 python3 scripts/ci/run_guards.py >/dev/null 2>&1; git status --porcelain | grep pytest-report.xml

routed_to: One line in .gitignore. Verify by running the guards and re-running `git status --porcelain` — the negative control is that the file IS produced by that run, so a clean status after the ignore is not a no-op.
what: pytest-report.xml is written into the repo root by the guards/pytest run and is not in .gitignore, so a session that runs the guards locally then finds an untracked file it did not create.
why_it_matters: It is a false positive on the exact probe a session uses to decide whether it has unlanded work — this session's stop-hook fired on it. A recurring false positive on a completion check trains the check to be ignored, which is the same failure mode as a wall of undispositioned rows.
